lines.zh: 我贴着墙飞，月亮跟不上。
lines.en: I skim the walls; the moon can't keep up.

lines.zh: 前面有活人的味道，还有心跳。
lines.en: Living scent ahead, and a heartbeat.

lines.zh: 我穿墙时，会留下一道绿。
lines.en: Passing through walls, I leave green.
Dirt still stuck where my wings join.
That click is me, not a door.

lines.zh: 从这堵墙穿过去，快得多。
lines.en: Through this wall is faster.
Sun dries my wing membrane.
I fly crooked; my shadow goes straight.
Hovering here, I forget who I chased.

lines.zh: 土里那股味，像我原来的窝。
lines.en: That soil smells like my old nest.
I drift; there are no steps to count.

lines.zh: 穿过石壁，也穿不回祭坛。
lines.en: I phase through stone, not back to the altar.
Chasing through walls is my specialty.

lines.zh: 那点火光，刺得我翅膜发颤。
lines.en: That flame makes my wing membrane quiver.

lines.zh: 眼眶里塞的是菌丝，不是眼。
lines.en: My sockets hold mycelium, not eyes.
My little wings beat furiously.

lines.zh: 静得能听见翅上的菌在长。
lines.en: So quiet I hear fungus growing on my wings.
A sculk vex does not fear light.
I buzz right by your ear.

lines.zh: 日头照在骨头上，还是凉。
lines.en: Sun on bone, still cold.
This body doesn't need to breathe.
Joints click, wings buzz.
I go through walls; you take the long way.

lines.zh: 我凑近，是想数你的睫毛。
lines.en: I lean in to count your lashes.
I still clutch a rune.

lines.zh: 你背后那堵墙，会让我过去。
lines.en: The wall behind you will let me through.
A warm face. Rare, lately.

lines.zh: 血色真好，我的骨是灰的。
lines.en: Such color. My bones are grey.

lines.zh: 你的影子，比你先到墙边。
lines.en: Your shadow reaches the wall before you.

lines.zh: 你走过的地方，风都留着味。
lines.en: The wind keeps your scent where you walked.

lines.zh: 我这张脸，像你见过的谁。
lines.en: This face. Does it look like someone you knew?
I bring my face close to hear it clearly.

lines.zh: 我翅膀的碎片，擦过你的脸。
lines.en: Fragments of my wing brushed your face.
You snapped a wing bone. That hurts.

lines.zh: 伤口漏的是绿屑，别沾手。
lines.en: Green dust leaks from the wound. Don't touch.

lines.zh: 活着的时候，这一下更疼。
lines.en: Alive, this hurt far worse.
Another piece shattered. Can't pick it up.

lines.zh: 我飞得没声音，只有咔哒。
lines.en: I fly silently. Only the click.
Numb. At least the buzzing stopped.

lines.zh: 打在我翅上，我掉了半尺。
lines.en: It hit my wing and I dropped a foot.
I'll carve your face into my wing.

lines.zh: 十点血，还能再飞一会儿。
lines.en: Ten points left. I can fly a while yet.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀薄得像一片腐叶。
lines.en: My wings are thin as a rotting leaf.
Still steaming, and my wings tremble.
I smelled this inside the grave.

lines.zh: 一口下去，我就飞你肩头。
lines.en: One bite and I'm on your shoulder for good.

lines.zh: 十点血的身子，饿得发飘。
lines.en: Ten points of body, floating with hunger.
Just a corner torn off. No more.
The smell of blood drifted in.
No teeth left. I can only lick.

lines.zh: 饿字刻在骨头上，擦不掉。
lines.en: Hunger's carved into the bone.
The steam rises; so do I.

lines.zh: 这不熟，是别的幽匿群落。
lines.en: Unfamiliar. A different sculk colony.

lines.zh: 撞得我翻了个身，才稳住。
lines.en: The bump flipped me; now I'm steady.
A click — who bumped me?

lines.zh: 我悬着，你却往我头上踩。
lines.en: I hover, and you step on my head.

lines.zh: 我一抖，绿屑全落在你身上。
lines.en: One shake and green dust falls on you.

lines.zh: 翅膜薄，经不起你的呼吸。
lines.en: My wings are thin; your breath could tear them.
I drift back a foot, sword still up.

lines.zh: 你的心跳，隔着骨头传过来。
lines.en: Your heartbeat reached me through bone.
One knock and I crumble to dust.
I never touch ground. Don't shove.

lines.zh: 我的剑是幽匿做的，很轻。
lines.en: My blade is sculk; it weighs nothing.

lines.zh: 两副凉骨头，靠一起也不暖。
lines.en: Two cold frames, no warmer together.

lines.zh: 下辈子，我长对能飞的翅膀。
lines.en: Next life, I'll grow wings that work.
However far you go, I phase after you.

lines.zh: 我栖在坟角，另一半空着。
lines.en: I roost in the grave corner; the other half is empty.
Dead once, and the thought remains.
Only a wing buzz in my chest.

lines.zh: 这身子生不出什么，也够用。
lines.en: This body breeds nothing, but it works.
Closer, and my blade might move first.

lines.zh: 我这把小剑，是幽匿磨出来的。
lines.en: This little sword was ground from sculk.

lines.zh: 这块幽匿，我捡它做什么。
lines.en: Why am I picking up this sculk?
I once clutched a shard like this.
Fingerprints still on it. Set down recently.
Into a wall crack, out of reach.

lines.zh: 我从土里扒出来，翅膀都脏。
lines.en: I clawed it from the dirt; my wings are filthy.
Bone fingers are slick. Nearly dropped it.
Holding it, I fly a little crooked.

lines.zh: 这块东西，我用骨手接住了。
lines.en: I caught this thing with bone fingers.

lines.zh: 我穿墙的时候，会掉绿屑。
lines.en: I shed green dust when I phase.

lines.zh: 十点血，我飞得快就够了。
lines.en: Ten health — flying fast is enough.

lines.zh: 隔着墙，我就听见你的心。
lines.en: I heard your heart through the wall.

lines.zh: 烟囱后面，看见你的影子。
lines.en: Behind the chimney. I saw your shadow.
Someone just out of doors smells clearest.

lines.zh: 别回头，来不及了，翼已张开。
lines.en: Do not look back; my wings are open.

lines.zh: 你抬头看，我已经在头顶。
lines.en: Look up. I'm already overhead.
A sculk vex comes through the wall.
My little blade is sculk-stained.
My hand is quicker than your feet.
Living one — the sculk has noted you.
No hurry. I'll circle you twice.
Don't turn. I'm behind your ear.

lines.zh: 恼鬼的剑，现在只有骨柄。
lines.en: My vex blade is only a bone hilt now.
I phased through a wall just for you.
Sculk vex. You shouldn't be here.
Ten of your steps, one beat of my wings.
Just once. My blade is short.

lines.zh: 找了这么久，原来你在这。
lines.en: All this searching. Here you were.
The more you pant, the faster I beat my wings.

lines.zh: 你影子往哪拐，我往哪拐。
lines.en: Where your shadow turns, I turn.

lines.zh: 幽匿丝吊着我，就在你头顶。
lines.en: Sculk threads hold me aloft, right above your head.

lines.zh: 我飘在半空，专挑落单的。
lines.en: I hover and pick off stragglers.
Legs broken, and I still chase.

lines.zh: 那扇门锁着，我穿过去了。
lines.en: That door's locked. I went through it.
When you're done panting, I'll come down.
Chased you from the village gate to here.
Fall, and I'll have to come down for you.
I pass through walls faster than flight.

lines.zh: 恼鬼的翅膀，一点点长菌。
lines.en: Fungus creeps over a vex's wings.

lines.zh: 火把圈里，我的翅太显眼。
lines.en: In torchlight my wings show too clearly.

lines.zh: 停一下，让我把剑收起来。
lines.en: Pause. Let me lower my blade.

lines.zh: 我飞得很碎，碎到你看不见。
lines.en: I fly so scattered you can't see me.

lines.zh: 翅膀不会酸，它们早烂了。
lines.en: These wings never ache. They rotted long ago.
No lungs. Just a chest of fungus.
I fly crooked but chase close.
My little sword rusts green.
These vex wings rotted through long ago.

lines.zh: 我不必呼吸，可我还是在追。
lines.en: I need not breathe, yet I still chase.
The blade's short; it caught your ear.
Ten health, and one touch scatters me.
One swing and my hand goes crooked.
One stab won't do, so two.
Only cloth. Next time I'll aim true.
A ten-point mosquito still bites.

lines.zh: 剑轻，可我撞过来的劲不轻。
lines.en: The blade is light; the charge isn't.

lines.zh: 翅膀没断，就能再冲一次。
lines.en: Wings intact, so I can charge again.
I can't pull back. My wings are too thin.
The small vex slams into you.
Ten points. Enough for one stab.

lines.zh: 倒下吧，别撑，幽匿会接住你。
lines.en: Fall; the sculk will catch you.

lines.zh: 咔哒声在你耳边，剑随后。
lines.en: The click at your ear, then the blade.

lines.zh: 我这点骨身，撞一下自己先散。
lines.en: This little bone body scatters on impact.

lines.zh: 我手里的小剑，只有一指长。
lines.en: My little sword is one finger long.
Roll over, dive once more.

lines.zh: 我从石缝里挤出来，翅上带灰。
lines.en: I squeeze out of the stone crack, ash on my wings.
I hover, never touching ground.

lines.zh: 穿过石头的我，不再是人。
lines.en: I pass through stone — no longer human.
The beams fell; my roost remains.
Too bright — my eyes sting.

lines.zh: 点上灯，我的翅就藏不住。
lines.en: Light the lamp and my wings lose their cover.
Colder in the brick gaps. I'm used to it.
The living should not come near.

lines.zh: 我悬着，脚底什么也没踩。
lines.en: I hover; nothing under my feet.
Stone grit still clings to my wings.

lines.zh: 幽匿的翅膀在暗处先响。
lines.en: Sculk wings rattle first in the dark.

lines.zh: 屋顶上转一圈，再挑一家。
lines.en: One lap of the rooftops, then pick a house.
The painting on the wall has faded.

lines.zh: 祭坛的石头，还认得我的翅。
lines.en: The altar stones still know my wings.

lines.zh: 幽匿烧起来，味道很难闻。
lines.en: Burning sculk stinks.
I hit the ground and bounced once.
A sculk thing has no lungs left.
The blast threw me onto a beam.
The arrow is wedged in my sculk seam, it hurts.
That light makes my bones burn.
Too hungry to beat my wings.
Lightning struck and I curled into a ball.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有墙，穿不过去。
lines.en: No walls in the void to phase through.
